d312_note: Between 5.5 V (VRWM) and the OVP ceiling D312 only sees a non-compliant source; leakage rises but it does not conduct.

inrush.note: TI gives tSS as typical only; a 1 ms soft start would still stay below 300 mA for ~1 ms

reverse.tpd1s514: Bidirectional nFET; body diode conducts VBUS_SYS to VBUS_CON (<= 1 A) only if USB_5V exceeds the connector, i.e. only in BQ25798 OTG mode. Firmware keeps EN_OTG = 0 (reset default). With USB absent nothing drives USB_5V: the BQ25798 has no SYS-to-VBUS path while not in OTG.
reverse.d324: BAT54 MCU_VBUS -> USB_5V conducts this discharge at ~0.3 V, below the LDO body path.
reverse.vbus_power: USB_VPWR is an internal LDO output; with USB absent it is unpowered and the divider holds U321 low (USB_ABSENT high).

module_pad31.detect: USBDETECTED after U323 delay + soft start (~24 ms) and U324 start-up; VBUS detect 3.4-4.3 V
